description: A fire panel zone: its detectors, call points and alarm valves report into it, and it signals its rooms, the PAHUs supplying them (fire shutdown) and the lifts (fire recall) (review A18). Unexported.

zone_circuit_fault.description: The zone circuit opens: device alarms in the zone no longer reach the panel and the zone raises no alarm outputs.

name: Fire alarm zone

alarm_delay.description: Verification delay before the zone raises its alarm outputs.

fire.description: Zone alarm signalling to its devices, rooms, PAHUs and lifts.
